reels.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks

editorial_notes.reasoning: This addresses 'recursive self-improvement'—the holy grail of AI discourse. It has high intrigue for non-specialists and fits perfectly into a 3Blue1Brown style visual exploration of how a model 'thinks about its own thinking' using a recursive loop.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if an AI could read its own report card and rewrite its own homework to get an A+ every time?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A mirror facing another mirror, but with a notepad in the middle where the reflection writes down how to improve its own posture.
